"""One-off calendar-only receipt review; no feature enrollment or provider runtime."""
import contextlib
import copy
from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = ROOT / "accepted"
manifest = json.loads((ROOT / "source_manifest.json").read_text())
for name, wanted in manifest["blobs"].items():
    data = (SOURCE / name).read_bytes()
    actual = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()
    assert actual == wanted, (name, actual, wanted)

# This affects only the disposable child process, never laptop or persisted config.
os.environ.clear()
os.environ["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"] = "1"
os.environ["GIT_SHA"] = manifest["commit"]
blocked_attempts = []
def audit(event, args):
    if event.startswith("socket.") or event in {"subprocess.Popen", "os.system", "os.exec", "os.posix_spawn"}:
        blocked_attempts.append(event)
        raise RuntimeError("Offline calendar review forbids network and child processes")
sys.addaudithook(audit)
sys.path.insert(0, str(SOURCE))
from src.config import config_resolver as cfg
from src.market_data.session_pct_change import covered_opening_window
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

receipt = json.loads((ROOT / "calendar_receipt.json").read_text())
transcript = json.loads((ROOT / "official_source_facts.json").read_text())
assert transcript["sources"][0]["facts"] == transcript["sources"][1]["facts"]
ET = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")
UTC = timezone.utc
rows = []
quiet = io.StringIO()
base = dict(RUN_MODE="READ_ONLY", ROSS_NEXT_SESSION_CATALYST_ENABLED=False,
            MARKET_SESSION_COVERAGE=json.dumps(receipt),
            MARKET_HOLIDAYS={date(2026, 11, 26)}, MARKET_HALF_DAYS={date(2026, 11, 27)},
            SESSION_PHASE_OVERRIDE=None)
def configure(**changes):
    cfg.set_config_overrides(dict(base, **changes))
    assert cfg.get_config("ROSS_NEXT_SESSION_CATALYST_ENABLED") is False
def check(name, instant, *, expected, prior=None, previous_close=None, phase=None, **kwargs):
    now = datetime.fromisoformat(instant) if isinstance(instant, str) else instant
    result = covered_opening_window(now, **kwargs)
    assert (result is not None) is expected, name
    if result is not None:
        assert result.target_session == now.astimezone(ET).date().isoformat(), name
        if prior is not None:
            assert result.previous_session == prior, name
        if previous_close is not None:
            assert result.previous_close.isoformat() == previous_close, name
        if phase is not None:
            assert result.phase == phase, name
    rows.append(dict(name=name, instant=now.isoformat(), admitted=result is not None,
                     snapshot=result.snapshot() if result else None))
    return result

with contextlib.redirect_stdout(quiet):
    assert cfg.get_config("ROSS_NEXT_SESSION_CATALYST_ENABLED") is False
    assert cfg.get_config("MARKET_SESSION_COVERAGE") == ""
    configure()
    # Each prospective OPEN target slice is validated separately. Nov13 is the prior anchor.
    open_days = [k for k, v in receipt["days"].items() if v["status"] == "OPEN"]
    for index, key in enumerate(open_days[1:], 1):
        day = date.fromisoformat(key)
        prior = open_days[index - 1]
        prior_hour = 13 if prior == "2026-11-27" else 16
        expected_prior_close = datetime.combine(date.fromisoformat(prior), datetime.min.time(), ET).replace(hour=prior_hour).astimezone(UTC).isoformat()
        def at(hour, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0):
            return datetime(day.year, day.month, day.day, hour, minute, second, microsecond, ET)
        check(key + " before PRE", at(3, 59, 59, 999999), expected=False)
        pre = check(key + " PRE start", at(4), expected=True, prior=prior, previous_close=expected_prior_close, phase="PRE")
        opening = check(key + " RTH open", at(9, 30), expected=True, prior=prior, phase="RTH_OPEN")
        assert pre.fingerprint == opening.fingerprint
        check(key + " before opening expiry", at(10, 29, 59, 999999), expected=True, prior=prior)
        check(key + " exact opening expiry", at(10, 30), expected=False)
        check(key + " RTH close", at(13 if key == "2026-11-27" else 16), expected=False)
        if key == "2026-11-27":
            assert opening.current_close.isoformat() == "2026-11-27T18:00:00+00:00"
    for key, value in receipt["days"].items():
        if value["status"] == "CLOSED":
            check(key + " explicit CLOSED date", key + "T14:40:00+00:00", expected=False)
    check("outside upper receipt coverage", "2026-12-01T14:40:00+00:00", expected=False)
    check("prior anchor has no covered prior", "2026-11-13T14:40:00+00:00", expected=False)
    check("naive evaluation", datetime(2026, 11, 16, 9, 30), expected=False)
    check("parameter override", "2026-11-16T14:40:00+00:00", expected=False, override_phase="RTH_OPEN")
    bad = copy.deepcopy(receipt)
    del bad["days"]["2026-11-15"]
    configure(MARKET_SESSION_COVERAGE=json.dumps(bad))
    check("missing intervening Sunday", "2026-11-16T14:40:00+00:00", expected=False)
    configure(MARKET_HOLIDAYS=set())
    check("holiday config conflict", "2026-11-27T14:40:00+00:00", expected=False)
    configure(MARKET_HALF_DAYS=set())
    check("half-day config conflict", "2026-11-30T14:40:00+00:00", expected=False)
    bad = copy.deepcopy(receipt)
    bad["days"]["2026-11-27"]["rth_close"] = "16:00"
    configure(MARKET_SESSION_COVERAGE=json.dumps(bad))
    check("wrong half-day receipt close", "2026-11-27T14:40:00+00:00", expected=False)
    bad = copy.deepcopy(receipt)
    bad["days"]["2026-11-16"]["opening_end"] = "11:30"
    configure(MARKET_SESSION_COVERAGE=json.dumps(bad))
    check("wrong project opening end", "2026-11-16T14:40:00+00:00", expected=False)
    configure(MARKET_SESSION_COVERAGE="")
    check("empty coverage", "2026-11-16T14:40:00+00:00", expected=False)
    configure(SESSION_PHASE_OVERRIDE="RTH_OPEN")
    check("configured override", "2026-11-16T14:40:00+00:00", expected=False)
    cfg.clear_config_overrides()
    assert cfg.get_config("ROSS_NEXT_SESSION_CATALYST_ENABLED") is False
    assert cfg.get_config("MARKET_SESSION_COVERAGE") == ""

assert not blocked_attempts, blocked_attempts
assert not any("ibkr" in name.lower() or name.startswith("src.scanner") for name in sys.modules)
hashes = {name: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          for name in ("calendar_receipt.json", "official_source_facts.json", "source_manifest.json")}
result = dict(status="PASS", calendar_calls=len(rows), source_commit=manifest["commit"],
              source_tree=manifest["tree"], python=sys.version.split()[0],
              reviewed_dates=transcript["bounded_dates"], open_target_slices=len(open_days)-1,
              covered_dates=len(receipt["days"]), feature_enabled=False,
              operational_config_persisted=False, observer_launched=False,
              network_or_child_process_attempts=blocked_attempts, hashes=hashes, cases=rows)
(ROOT / "dry_run_results.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "cases"}, indent=2))
